summary.text: Erik Kiehle is a property manager and the Libertarian nominee in the 3rd District. He holds a bachelor's degree from the University of California, Riverside. In his Ballotpedia survey he describes his candidacy as an alternative to the Democratic and Republican parties and lists balancing the budget as a key message.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree from the University of California, Riverside (1994).
Says his first job was at Baskin-Robbins during high school and summer college breaks.
Is the Libertarian candidate on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for the 3rd District.
